assign.request: Reviewer minion for /imagine/feeds/: ten-second test, primary interaction, layout at 3440, resolve findings in-realm, land.

log.msg: Ten-second test (before fix), 1280 shot: stranger sentence - three cards labelled Video/Data/Live, each with a truncated description ending in an ellipsis, and directly underneath, the exact same three names repeated as a plain link list - I cannot tell why both exist or which one to click. Meant sentence (readme.md intro + page.js content()): three small labs, each a different shape of content the repo does not author itself - a YouTube embed you have to ask for, one dataset drawn three ways, and a live public weather API - click through and each ends in a one-line verdict. Confirmed exactly the paging/critique feeds row: rank 5, 31pct wide, 2180px dead, depth 6, weak = a 3-card preview row sits directly above an identical 3-item text list, alt = drop the duplicate list, let the card row claim wide and become the whole index. Alternate was NOT applied before this task (same missing index: true bug already found and fixed in gallery/ and design/).

Fix 1 (the whole finding): page.js gets width: large + index: true. Root cause was core Page.class.js column() - unless a page sets index: true, core lists its children a second time as a plain rail underneath whatever content() already drew; content() here already calls this.previews() to draw Video/Data/Live as cards, so the rail below was a verbatim repeat. Same bug, same fix already shipped on /imagine/gallery/ and /imagine/design/ earlier tonight. width: large (28-64em) lets the three cards sit in one row instead of stacking in the 40em default track. Caveat: chose large over full deliberately - gallery doc/decisions.md already recorded and reverted a full regression that collapses /imagine/s hub rail; verified live at both 1280 and 3440 that the hub rail (Imagine/Team/Design/... sidebar) survives with large. Undo to full only if this wall grows past ~4-5 children and the owner decides the rail matters less than filling the row.

Primary interaction verified via ui-test drive.mjs (scratchpad feeds-plan3.json/feeds-ui3, feeds-plan4.json/feeds-ui4): clicking the first card (Video), scoped selector .page--feeds .page-preview:nth-of-type(1) a (unscoped matched 33 hidden .page-preview nodes site-wide and timed out - the columns-page two-of-every-selector trap), navigates to /imagine/feeds/video/, crumb updates to Imagine Feeds Video, a real 5-talk picker rail renders with speaker names under each title. Followed one hop deeper to /imagine/feeds/video/jobs/: 0 iframes on load (eval), 1 iframe with correct youtube-nocookie.com src after clicking the play button - the lazy-embed claim in readme.md and doc/decisions.md holds today, unchanged. Zero console errors on all four pages (landing, video/, data/, live/), checked separately.

Layout at 3440 after the fix: nothing sits at x:0 (the /imagine/ hub rail is site chrome, flush left by design on every realm, not this pages own content). No text line runs past ~40em - the intro paragraph wraps well inside page-column-prose. No hard-coded spacing constant duplicating a clamp in feeds.css - .feeds-data uses the flex/gap utility (var(--gap, var(--gap-default))) already, and the small per-component paddings (chips, cards, rows) are not page-layout rhythm. One core-level spacing item noted but NOT fixed (out of fences): Page.css .page-previews sets --gap: 0.8em as a fixed value instead of routing through --gap-default - shared by every previews() wall sitewide, not feeds-specific, so left as a proposal rather than edited.

assign.outcome:
**Feeds' landing page stopped showing the same three links twice; its takeaway sentence was already fine.**

- Root cause: `page.js` was missing `index: true` — core's `column()` was listing Video/Data/Live a second time as a plain rail underneath the `previews()` card row `content()` already draws. Same bug, same fix already shipped tonight on `/imagine/gallery/` and `/imagine/design/`. Matches `paging/critique`'s feeds row exactly (31% wide, 2180px dead, weak = 'the same three links twice').
- Added `width: "large"` alongside it so the three cards sit in one row; verified the `/imagine/` hub rail survives at both 1280 and 3440 (chose `large` over `full` deliberately — `full` was tried and reverted on `/imagine/gallery/` for exactly this regression).
- Primary interaction verified end to end with `ui-test`: Video card → `/imagine/feeds/video/` → a talk → play button → 0 iframes before, 1 correct `youtube-nocookie.com` iframe after. Zero console errors on all four pages (landing, video/, data/, live/).
- Documented the fix in `readme.md` and `doc/decisions.md` so no future pass reintroduces it.

![Feeds, fixed](/framework/ai/2026-09-04/imagine-review/shots/feeds.jpg)

One observation, not a formal proposal (core CSS, shared by every realm's card wall, not feeds-specific): `core/Page/Page.css`'s `.page-previews` sets `--gap: 0.8em` as a fixed value instead of the sitewide spacing clamp.
